label: In a bare clone the first routed request is not blocked: the trigger-index lookup exits 0, and skill-advisor.cjs advisor_recommend exits 0 but serves from a degraded local scorer (degraded:true, source:local-scorer); the pre-build failure mode is silent routing-quality reduction, not refusal.

Per-runtime wiring ships pre-wired with two mechanisms: .opencode wires agents/bin/commands/hooks/scripts/skills/repo-rules through relative symlinks into ../.skilled/*, while .pi/.claude/.codex/.cursor/.devin carry real mirrored dirs plus per-runtime configs; all sampled MCP configs point at the tracked .skilled/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs, so no runtime-specific setup step is needed for the first request in the sampled runtimes.

Tracked clutter: 8 of 468 tracked symlinks dangle in the fresh clone; .opencode/plugins/sk-vision.js is known, .skilled/changelog/cli-jev/cli-usage and parent dangle in the maintainer worktree too, and four spec-scratch symlinks point at /Users/michelkerkmeester/... absolute paths that can never resolve for another user. No observed failure names any of them.

Absent credentials are not a first-walk stumble: .utcp_config.json is tracked with seven variable placeholders and no secrets, the per-runtime MCP configs need only the tracked launcher, and README names per-integration keys as surface-dependent; Code Mode's install routine lives in the skills catalog rather than the numbered steps.

The sk-vision delivery gap is now observed end-to-end: in the clone, bun install (33 packages, exit 0) plus bun run build (exit 0) emitted dist/plugin.js, dist/prompt-evidence.js, dist/vision-cli.js, dist/python/runtime.py and hooks/opencode/sk-vision.js, after which the tracked .opencode/plugins/sk-vision.js symlink resolves. Two commands under one minute close the dangling-symlink failure; the original test-failure claim stays falsified.

Final ranked fix set: F1 (P1) drop README.md:162's false advisor auto-build claim; F2 (P1) state Code Mode's Node requirement at README.md:160; F3 (P2) introduce sk-vision's Bun prerequisite and two-command setup; F4 (P2) move the hook-trust requirement into the numbered steps; F5 (P3) note step 3 depends on step 2; F6 (P3, optional) root tracked-clutter cleanup only if bundled. Every move is change-prose-in-place or one added sentence, each with its climbing sentence naming the failure left by build-nothing; fixes for the z_archive dependence and the advisor degraded mode are not earned.
